name: Liberation of Auschwitz
summary: WWII / Holocaust: Soviet troops liberate Auschwitz-Birkenau, exposing the scale of Nazi mass murder.

name: Yalta Conference
summary: WWII: Allied leaders meet to plan final victory and the postwar order.

name: Bombing of Dresden
summary: WWII: Allied bombing devastates Dresden, remaining one of the war's most controversial air raids.

name: Battle of Iwo Jima
summary: WWII: U.S. Marines capture Iwo Jima after fierce fighting, providing airfields for the campaign against Japan.

name: Battle of Okinawa
summary: WWII: The largest battle of the Pacific War begins, with massive military and civilian losses.

name: Battle of Berlin
summary: WWII: Soviet forces launch the final assault on Berlin as Nazi Germany collapses.

name: Death of Adolf Hitler
summary: WWII: Hitler commits suicide in Berlin as Soviet forces close in.

name: Victory in Europe Day
summary: WWII: Germany surrenders unconditionally, ending the war in Europe.

name: Atomic Bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki
summary: WWII: The United States drops atomic bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, killing vast numbers of civilians and accelerating Japan's surrender.

name: Japan Surrenders
summary: WWII: Japan formally surrenders aboard USS Missouri, ending World War II.
